answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 31955 Country: India Title: Is it Haraam to eat while standing? Also, can a woman trim her hair? Question: (1) Is it Haraam to eat while standing? (2) Also, can a woman trim her hair? Answer ID: 31955 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 929/605/H=1432) (1) It is haram if it is with the intention to imitate the debauched persons; if there is no such intention then also this is undesirable, rather makrooh. (2) It (trimming hair for women) is unlawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
